evidence.excerpt: For example, Roderick Chisholm (1964) and Peter Klein (1971) have characterized defeaters as follows: (D1) When evidence e justifies S in believing that p, then proposition d is a defeater for S’s justification if and only if (i) d is true and (ii) the conjunction of d and e does not justify S in believing that p.
